videos.title: [Ranking News] "Is that not coffee?" Starbucks boycott spreads / SBS / News Hunters
videos.subtitle_summary: 5월 22일의 뉴스 톱3. 1위: Starbucks boycott spreads due to government agencies. 2위: Safe return of Korean activists from Gaza. 3위: Home invasion incident involving actress Kim Gu-ri. Actress Kim Gu-ri and her friend were attacked by a man at their home in Seoul's Hannok Village on the night of May 19th. The intruder attempted to tie them up and demanded 30 million won, but they managed to escape. CCTV footage of their dramatic escape was released. Korean activist Kim Ah-hyeon safely returned from Gaza after being detained by Israeli forces. Despite reports of torture, she had difficulty recognizing her own face due to multiple beatings. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed concern over the Israeli crackdown on activists. This is not the first time Kim has been arrested in Gaza. She was released two days after being detained last October. However, her passport has since been revoked. Despite this, she plans to continue traveling to Gaza until her fellow Palestinians are freed. The top news of the day is the spread of the Starbucks boycott initiated on 5.18 Tank Day, with government agencies participating. The Ministry of Defense, the Ministry of National Defense, and the Ministry of Justice have taken various measures against Starbucks.

videos.title: 국민연금 1800조 육박…수익률 효자 국내주식 늘릴까? / KBS  2026.05.22.
videos.subtitle_summary:
1. 국민연금 금액은 올해 300조원 이상으로 증가했고, 코스피는 80% 이상 상승한 것으로 나타났습니다. 국내 주식의 비중도 18%에서 24.5%로 늘었습니다.
2. 국민연금 자산 배분 전략상, 올해 국내 주식 보유 한도는 14.9%를 초과하여 10% 포인트 가까이 늘었습니다. 지난 1월부터는 주식 처분을 일시적으로 유해했으나, 결정은 아직 나지 않았습니다.
3. 국민들의 관심이 높아지고 있고, 자산 배분에 대한 의견이 다양하며, 올해와 내년도 국내 주식 한도를 어떻게 설정할지는 쟁점입니다. 위험을 분산하고 적절한 자산 배분 체계가 필요합니다.
